children: ICICI Securities research report on Onesource Specialty Pharma

We recently visited OneSource’s drug-device combination (DDC) manufacturing plant in Bangalore. OneSource is the only CDMO with generic semaglutide approvals across the G7 nations. Its customers have made significant strides in the semaglutide market across India, Canada and Saudi Arabia, and are expected to foray into Brazil, Turkey, LATAM and Southeast Asian countries over the next few months. To meet its slated FY28 guidance amid rising demand, the company expanded its DDC capacity by ~3.5-5x to 700-950 litres in Sep’26, and plans to add another 500-750 litres of capacity in Mar’27.

It is also expanding its biologics and biosimilars footprint by securing five new client partnerships and scaling its capacities (with mammalian and microbial capacities set to increase by ~2x and 6x, respectively). Retain BUY with an unchanged TP of INR 2,400.
